observed: a POMDP separates hidden state from observation and defines observation likelihood separately from state transition
decisions are made from a belief representation rather than assuming the latest observation is the true state
belief is updated from prior belief, action and new observation
records.derived_pattern: When the relevant world state is only partially observed, maintain an explicit belief/current-hypothesis state and update it from observations instead of equating observation with reality.
records.behavioral_consequence: For incomplete evidence, separate OBSERVED from LATENT/INFERRED state and record how new evidence updates the live belief set; do not silently collapse uncertainty to the latest observation.

observed: controller management separates command interfaces from state interfaces
controller and hardware lifecycle state changes are explicitly published
fallback activation depends on current state/command interface availability
real-time control reliability depends on update timing and avoiding unsafe/blocking operations in the control loop
records.derived_pattern: Effectful control should keep observed state, intended command, lifecycle availability and timing/currentness as separate variables.
records.behavioral_consequence: Do not infer effect success from command issuance. Before dependent actions, verify resulting state and relevant resource/interface availability; for timing-sensitive loops, track latency/jitter as correctness-relevant evidence.

observed: each reader exposes a consistent point-in-time view of the index
writes after a reader is opened are not visible until the reader is explicitly refreshed/reopened
internal document numbers are ephemeral and may change as the index changes
records.derived_pattern: Retrieval answers are conditional on a corpus/index snapshot; mutable retrieval surfaces require explicit refresh/currentness and durable identity must not depend on ephemeral internal positions.
records.behavioral_consequence: When retrieval currentness matters, bind evidence to source/version or retrieval snapshot, refresh after known corpus mutations, and never treat transient rank/document-position identifiers as durable source identity.

observed: convergence checks can be unavailable or unreliable when sample count or chain count is insufficient
R-hat and effective sample size are used as diagnostics rather than assuming a sample automatically represents a reliable posterior
divergences and tree-depth problems are surfaced separately from nominal sample production
records.derived_pattern: Producing many candidate outputs is not evidence that the generating/search process is reliable; process adequacy requires diagnostics distinct from output quantity.
records.behavioral_consequence: For stochastic or multi-run reasoning/evaluation, track run diversity, disagreement, failure modes and effective independent evidence before increasing confidence; repeated correlated outputs do not count as independent confirmation.

observed: individual versions carry their own identifiers while a concept identifier represents the version family
the concept DOI is described as resolving to the latest version
version relations are serialized explicitly as isVersionOf/hasVersion relationships
records.derived_pattern: A stable family/concept identity and an exact artifact-version identity serve different purposes and must not be conflated.
records.behavioral_consequence: For reproducibility bind claims to exact versions/heads; use family/concept identifiers only to refer to the evolving lineage, and label moving aliases as such.
